svg.title: Figure 25.3 · Exact resume, and the fallback's dent
svg.desc: Training loss of each step's batch before its update, for 60 steps. Run B, stopped after step 29 and resumed, logs exactly run A's numbers. Run C starts step 30 with A's weights but a restarted sampler, so its step-30 loss of 2.10 against A's 1.73 is a different batch; its fresh optimizer moments act from step 31, and it ends with a worse val loss on the same windows.
svg.text: Resuming exactly, and resuming without the optimizer
train.py --preset 30b on a byte corpus, CPU · logged training loss per step · book example ch25_resume.py
A uninterrupted, and B stopped and resumed: the same numbers
C resumed from the best-val file (A's weights at step 29): fresh moments, restarted data order
